summary: Initial release of ChronoTrack Health — your chronic condition tracker with AI pattern detection. Approved and live on the App Store and Google Play. Designed for patients (free) and healthcare professionals (paid). Full offline-first, privacy-first tracking with pluggable connector framework.
included: 11 free core features: onboarding, home dashboard with dark-theme module cards, log entry (pain 1-10, body location, triggers, medications), calendar view, pattern analysis, medications manager, entry history with search, daily check-in, emergency card, quick log, and settings

7 Plus features ($3.99/mo): trigger insights with frequency bars, flare timeline, health journal, PDF report export (7/14/30/90 day), symptom comparison, medication effectiveness charts, encrypted data backup

8 Pro features ($29.99/mo): Data Hub, Connector Store, Connector Builder (6-step wizard), patient dashboard, SOAP report generator with FHIR R4 export, API Key Vault, audit log with cost tracking, premium upgrade screen
PatternEngine — on-device trend analysis with 6 insight types (frequency, trend, worst day, peak time, triggers, med effectiveness)
WeatherService via Open-Meteo — weather correlation with 3-hour cache and freshness indicators
DrugInfoService via OpenFDA — drug lookup with offline interaction database (10 known pairs)
ResearchService via PubMed E-Utils — research search with 7-day cache
ConnectorRuntime — executes REST, FHIR R4, CSV, and RSS connectors with auth and budget controls
17 SwiftData/Room entities: 11 core, 3 cache, 3 framework models
StoreKit 2 (iOS) and Google Play Billing (Android) IAP integration
All clinical content cites NIH, WHO, CDC, FDA, APA, and AHA
100% offline — no account, no server, no tracking, no data collection
Full cross-platform feature parity between iOS and Android
